name: CogentNexus OpenClaw Bridge
description: Ticket-first OpenClaw bridge for CogentNexus Host-managed continuity, durable execution, recovery, context handoff, and verified delivery.

autoResume.description: Schedule one durable continuation turn after a resumable interruption.

autoRotate.description: Opt in to a clean TaskFlow/Codex worker for ROTATE handoffs. Disabled by default.

workspaceDir.description: Workspace containing CogentNexus durable state and workflow completion outboxes.

autoWorkflowCompletion.description: Automatically wake the bound owner when a workflow reaches a terminal state.

enforcedMode.description: Enforce owner/session and managed workflow authority boundaries.

preInferenceAdmission.description: Route obvious durable owner requests before the selected conversational model receives the prompt.

durableWorkerModel.description: Ollama model used by automatically compiled bounded workflow components.

ticketFirst.description: Commit every eligible owner message to SQLite before inference. Host-managed installs enable this by default.

ticketDatabasePath.description: Optional SQLite Ticket database path. Defaults under workspace .cogent/runtime.

ticketDispatchLimit.description: Maximum Tickets claimed per dispatch tick.

ticketLeaseMs.description: Ticket worker lease and heartbeat extension.

ticketMinimumFreeMemoryBytes.description: Minimum observed free memory before Ticket dispatch.

ticketMinimumFreeDiskBytes.description: Minimum observed free disk before Ticket dispatch.

ticketMaximumAttempts.description: Maximum Ticket claim attempts before a retryable failure becomes terminal.

knowledgeEnabled.description: Enable the additive SQLite Experience/Lesson store. Retrieval remains optional and never controls durable execution.

externalResearchEnabled.description: Enable bounded external-research job storage and evidence ingestion. Network access still requires an explicit capability adapter.
